# KK Studio instructions

Before editing, read root `RULES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `AI_RULES.md`, then `docs/FIGMA-SYNC.md` (for UI/tokens), `docs/engineering/SDLC.md`, `docs/engineering/BRANCH-POLICY.md`, `docs/engineering/REVIEW.md`, `docs/engineering/PROMPTING.md`, and current `docs/governance/` sources.
Auto-load domain memory without user prompting: detect task domain and inspect `docs/governance/ai-memory/` (e.g. `ui-motion.md` for UI; `node scripts/governance/ai-memory.mjs read <domain>`). For UI buttons, clarify action/loading/fallback if unclear. Never make drive-by edits outside task scope (`RULE-NO-DRIVEBY`), write zero-bloat code, and clean up temporary files in `.tmp/` upon completion. Use task branches, actual tests, and independent review; never direct-push main. Summarize in concise Chinese.
